description: This file implements GPU-accelerated linear (fully connected) operations in the XNNPACK backend for PyTorch, including creation, execution, and validation of XNNPACK-based linear operators.

classes.name: ContextLinear
classes.description: A context object for managing the state of an XNNPACK linear operator.

methods.name: bool available(const Tensor & weight,const std::optional<Tensor> & bias,const float output_min,const float output_max)
methods.description: Checks if the provided weight and bias tensors, along with output bounds, support creating an XNNPACK linear operator.

methods.name: bool usable(const Tensor & input)
methods.description: Checks if the input tensor is suitable for running the XNNPACK linear operator.

methods.name: ContextLinear create(const Tensor & weight,const std::optional<Tensor> & bias,const float output_min,const float output_max)
methods.description: Creates an XNNPACK fully connected (linear) operator with the given weight, bias, and output bounds.

methods.name: Tensor run(const ContextLinear & context,const Tensor & input)
methods.description: Executes the XNNPACK linear operator on the given input tensor.

methods.name: c10::intrusive_ptr<xnnpack::LinearOpContext> createLinearClampPrePackOpContext(Tensor weight,std::optional<Tensor> bias,const std::optional<Scalar> & output_min,const std::optional<Scalar> & output_max)
methods.description: Prepares a packed linear operator context with optional output clamping bounds.

methods.name: Tensor linear_clamp_run(const Tensor & input,const c10::intrusive_ptr<xnnpack::LinearOpContext> & op_context)
methods.description: Runs a pre-packed XNNPACK linear operator context on input.

methods.name: IValue unpack_prepacked_sizes_linear(const IValue & ivalue)
methods.description: Extracts sizes of the weight and bias tensors from a pre-packed linear operator.

methods.name: bool use_linear(const Tensor & input,const Tensor & weight,const Tensor & bias)
methods.description: Determines if the linear operation can be performed with XNNPACK based on tensor properties.

methods.name: Tensor linear(const Tensor & input,const Tensor & weight,const Tensor & bias)
methods.description: Performs the linear transformation using XNNPACK.
